verified_facts: Title: 3BHK Karamadai | 3.25Cent | 2000Sq.ft Build-up Area | 83Lakhs | Coimbatore., Description: East Facing site and main door, 3.25 Cents, 2000 sqft built-up area, DTCP approved site, 7000L Sump, Borewell., Description details: Ground floor parking, living hall, pooja room, kitchen, 1 bedroom with attached bathroom, 1 outer toilet; First floor living hall, 2 bedrooms with attached bathrooms, balcony., Video: Tour showing front exterior facade, tiled parking space, living room with false ceiling lighting and TV unit wall, kitchen with fitted cabinetry, bedrooms with wardrobes, and fully tiled modern bathrooms.

content_plan.style: Relaxed and engaging local property walk-through presenter speaking directly to camera with natural conversational Tamil.
content_plan.hook_strategy: Highlighting a spacious 3BHK independent villa in Karamadai off Mettupalayam Road at 83 Lakhs.

scenes.name: location
scenes.voice: கோவை மேட்டுப்பாளையம் ரோடு காரமடையில, ஒரு அருமையான 3BHK Independent Villa பாக்கலாமா!

scenes.name: land
scenes.voice: இது 3.25 Cents land area-ல அமைஞ்சிருக்கு... நல்ல விசாலமான covered car parking வசதியும் இருக்கு.

scenes.name: builtUp
scenes.voice: 2000 sq ft built-up area! Ground floor-ல living hall, pooja room, modular kitchen, 1 bedroom... First floor-ல living, 2 bedrooms, balcony-னு செமையா கட்டிருக்காங்க. LED false ceiling, fitted wardrobes, borewell மற்றும் 7000L sump கூட இருக்கு!

scenes.name: facing
scenes.voice: இதுல முக்கியமான விஷயம், இது pure East facing site மற்றும் main door.

scenes.name: approval
scenes.voice: அதே மாதிரி, இது முழுசா DTCP approved property.

scenes.name: cta
scenes.voice: நேர்ல வந்து site visit பண்ணவும், மேலும் details பெறவும் உடனே call பண்ணுங்க!
